title: Fresh Command Only
summary: Give a virtual web command a lease and return the output to off when it expires.

briefing.text: Give a virtual web command a lease and return the output to off when it expires.
The parts are placed but unwired. Complete the wiring and sketch, then follow the experiments in Learn to earn each objective.

learn.title: Fresh Command Only
learn.body:
Wire GPIO18 → 220 Ω → LED → GND. Start a virtual WiFi access point with WiFi.softAP("VoltQuest-Control") and WebServer on port 80. This network stays inside the simulator.

Serve GET /on, /off and /status. /on drives the LED high, records millis() and replies ON; every fresh /on renews a 750 ms lease. /off immediately drives low and replies OFF. /status reports the current ON or OFF state without renewing anything. Once 750 ms elapses since the last /on, turn off and print EXPIRED once. Keep handleClient() and expiry checks running without delay().

In Phone, request /on and /status promptly. Then wait more than one second and request /status again: it must say OFF. Finally request /off to verify the explicit stop endpoint. A stale command must not hold the output on indefinitely. This LED exercise demonstrates timeout behavior, not a hardware safety certification.
